svg.text: MuMax3 at 4.19M cells: Apple proxy model vs measured CUDA GPUs
CUDA bars come from bench/gpus.txt. Apple M4 10c was measured on the Metal backend; all other Apple central values and whiskers are proxy-model results, not MuMax3 benchmarks or confidence intervals.
